concept.prompt:

Input image 1: Hanna identity and outfit reference, a woman in a black ankle-length elegant dress, black blazer, long straight dark brown hair, angular black sunglasses, black pointed-toe low-heeled shoes, a small black shoulder handbag with a delicate gold chain. Use only the subject from this photograph, not the phone UI or café.
Input image 2: exact art-style and board layout reference: Darya's warm, richly textured high-quality chibi pixel art, large expressive head, readable full-body silhouette, dark navy retro arcade border, cream character-turnaround section, magenta/gold accents.
Create a finished high-quality landscape HANNA character board in this exact Demian art style. One large full-body Hanna portrait on the left with confident gentle smile and sophisticated graceful relaxed posture. master.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production source sprite sheet for HANNA / حنا in Demian, matching the supplied approved Hanna design board's richly shaded detailed pixel-art/chibi style and identity.
Create one genuinely transparent RGBA sprite sheet: EXACTLY 6 rows and EXACTLY 8 columns, 48 separate complete full-body poses, one person per cell. No labels, no grids, no borders, no background colors, no shadows, no text, no decorative particles. Generous transparent gutters between poses and around all outer edges; no hair, fingers, handbag or shoes may touch adjacent cells. All poses have the same head/body scale, hair length, face, clothing and small purse.
Identity: long dark brown hair with warm chestnut highlights and a soft side part, angular black sunglasses, warm light-medium skin, composed smile, black ankle-length dress with readable charcoal folds, open black blazer, small black purse with fine gold shoulder chain and plain gold clasp (no logo), black pointed-toe low-heel shoes. Never give her Darya's cat, a weapon, wings or a companion. Fashionable graceful silhouette and balanced readable supporting foot.
ROW 1, eight turnarounds in this exact order: front facing viewer, front-left 45°, left profile, back-left 45°, full back, back-right 45°, right profile, front-right 45°. All standing naturally upright and complete.
ROW 2, eight IDLE frames, all facing right in 3/4 side view: subtle breathing and composed elegant weight-shift cycle, relaxed hands, tiny purse/hair sway, same anatomical size.
ROW 3, eight WALK frames, all right-facing: a COMPLETE single cycle over both supporting feet, right foot contact, passing, left foot contact, passing. Graceful deliberate steps; forearms swing oppositely to the legs, ankle and knee flexion visible, flowing hem and hair follow the motion. Do not duplicate all eight poses.
ROW 4, eight JUMP sequence poses, all right-facing, chronological: standing anticipation; knee bend and arms back; upward push-off with arms forward; rising with one knee tucked; apex with both bent legs and balanced arms; falling with legs extended; soft bent-knee touchdown; balanced upright recovery. Body/head stay the same size. All are full bodies even airborne.
ROW 5, eight LAND recovery poses, all right-facing: soft crouched landing, absorb impact with knees and arms, then smoothly rise into graceful standing. No impact particles.
ROW 6, eight CELEBRATE poses: front-right view, composed small wave transitioning to a tasteful raised-hand victory smile and back to poised standing; purse secured, clothing consistent.
Each row contains EXACTLY 8 figures. Keep them upright/readable except actual required limb motion. Fine clean crisp pixel-art edges with real alpha, no giant blur, no photorealism. The picture is used as game art, so matching identity and clean non-overlapping silhouettes are essential.

motion.prompt:

EXACTLY 4 rows x 8 columns = 32 complete separate full-body figures. Make the sheet a wide landscape canvas with enough height for all FOUR rows: never crop the bottom row. Use the exact approved Hanna identity: warm light-medium skin, long flowing dark brown hair with chestnut highlights, angular black sunglasses, composed little smile, open black blazer, ankle-length black dress with charcoal readable folds, black pointed-toe small-heel shoes, small black purse secured on a fine gold shoulder chain with plain clasp, no logo. Rich detailed chibi pixel art matching Darya/Demian. No other people, no companion, no wings.
ROW 1: eight frames of a COMPLETE RIGHT-FACING WALK CYCLE. Elegant grounded walking, not jumping. Phase order: right heel forward contact with left foot behind; right foot plant; left foot passing; left foot forward swing; left heel forward contact with right foot behind; left foot plant; right foot passing; right foot forward swing. At least ONE foot touches the ground line in EVERY walk frame. Small opposing arm swing, subtle hip rotation, poised shoulders, slight hem and hair sway. No giant leap or bent-knee flight in this row.
ROW 2: eight frames of a COMPLETE RIGHT-FACING RUN CYCLE. Same scale, confident poised slight forward lean, both legs alternate, bent elbows oppose the legs, controlled knee lifts, brief flight between planted steps, the flowing dress reveals the moving shoes without changing clothing. Eight clearly distinct sequential poses, no sprinting frenzy.
ROW 3: eight RIGHT-FACING LANDING RECOVERY frames. Start softly crouched with flexed knees and arms forward to absorb impact, then rise progressively over all eight frames into upright graceful standing. Dress, sunglasses, purse and hair stay consistent. No dust or particles.
ROW 4: eight FRONT-RIGHT-FACING CELEBRATE frames, COMPLETE FULL BODIES INCLUDING DRESS HEM, BOTH LEGS AND SHOES: poised standing, lift one hand, small elegant wave, wave peak, tasteful raised-hand victory smile, lower hand, returning wave, poised standing. No large acrobatics. Leave real transparent blank canvas below the feet of all eight bottom-row figures.
Each row has exactly eight figures, none overlaps another or touches the outer canvas. No labels, text, cell borders, ground shadows, colored background, checkerboard or props beyond her purse. Every figure including the bottom row MUST be fully inside the canvas.

No brown rectangular backdrop, no translucent wash, no ground shadows and no checkerboard pixels. Preserve fine character edge antialiasing and the solid opaque pixel art within each character. Do not redraw the poses or change the four rows or eight columns. This edit changes only background transparency.

slides.prompt:
Asset type: dedicated low crouch and slide production sprites for HANNA in the Demian game. Match Hanna in the supplied design board exactly: same detailed warm shaded chibi pixel art, long dark brown/chestnut hair, angular black sunglasses, black open blazer, black ankle-length dress, black pointed-toe low heels, tiny black purse with fine gold shoulder chain and plain clasp. No cat, wings, weapons, logos or extra people.
Create EXACTLY 2 rows x 4 columns = EIGHT separate COMPLETE figures on a genuinely transparent RGBA canvas. No text, outlines of grid cells, scenery, floor, shadows, particles, checkerboard or brown backdrop. Generous empty transparent gaps around each figure.
ALL eight figures face RIGHT and are authentically drawn LOW SLIDE poses: knees folded compactly near the ground, torso leans forward diagonally, one hand balances close to the ground, dress drapes over folded knees, shoes visible, hair and blazer gently trail backward, purse secured close to hip. Keep the SAME HEAD/FACE SIZE as standing Hanna, never vertically compress the character. Pose height should be only about 60–65% of her standing body height with the same anatomical head size. Compact silhouette: avoid very wide outstretched straight legs.
Top row: four chronological low entry poses, starting already fully crouched, lowering into slide, weight moving forward, settled low slide.
Bottom row: four chronological loopable extremely LOW and compact slide poses with subtle arm, bent-leg and hair variations. Head stays low; all eight silhouettes must fit beneath a low runner obstacle. The bottom row is the actual gameplay slide loop. All shoes, purse, fingers and hair fully inside each cell. Include full lower bodies in the second row with ample transparent margin below them. Crisp pixel-art edges, opaque characters, actual zero-alpha background.
